description: A utility Kotlin object providing string manipulation functions by delegating to underlying JoinUtils and SplitUtils, involving custom LinkedList data structure.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: Utility object containing functions to join and split strings using custom linked list data structure.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a LinkedList of strings into a single string using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a LinkedList of strings using SplitUtils.
